fix(mcp-tools): a prompt update changes only what the caller sent (#503)

## Summary

After this merges, a prompt update changes only what the caller sent:
adding or removing a list item leaves the rest of the YAML file as it
was, resending a script tool keeps its `tool.yaml`, and the reply says
which tools a `tools` list left unbound.

- An update that adds or removes a list item (a prompt's `tools`,
`arguments` or `chain_steps`, and the same in gates, frameworks and
categories) changes only those lines. Before, the whole file was
re-rendered: comments inside the list were dropped and long lines it
never touched were re-wrapped.
- Resending a script tool that already exists edits its `tool.yaml` in
place. Comments, key order, `env`, `schemaFile`, `confirmMessage`,
`enabled: false` and an authored `confirm: true` survive; before, the
file was regenerated from nine fields and `confirm` was reset to
`false`.
- A tool created through `resource_manager` without `confirm` now asks
for approval before it runs, as the loader and
`docs/guides/script-tools.md` already said. Until now it was written as
`confirm: false`.
- Sending `tools` on an update still replaces the list. The parameter
description now says so, and the reply names each tool left out and says
its folder was kept.

## Demonstration

`resource_manager(resource_type:"prompt", action:"update",
id:"reference_demo", tools:[word_count])` on the bundled prompt, which
had two tools:

**Before**

```
✅ Created tool 'word_count' in …/tools/word_count
prompt.yaml   comments 5 → 1, 133-column description folded onto two lines
tool.yaml     comments 20 → 0, keys reordered, 1248 → 221 bytes
```

**After**

```
✅ Updated tool 'word_count' in …/tools/word_count
⚠️ Unbound tool 'text_digest': it was left out of `tools`, which replaces the list. Its folder was kept at …/tools/text_digest; to delete it, send tool_operation:"remove", tool_ids:["text_digest"], confirm:true.
prompt.yaml   original minus the `- text_digest` line; comments 5 → 5
tool.yaml     byte-identical
```

## How it was verified

| Claim | Probe | Baseline → measured | Mutation that fails it |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| A list-length change keeps comments and untouched lines |
`server/tests/integration/resources/yaml-source-preservation.test.ts`
(hand-authored fixtures; block, flow and nested lists; first, middle,
last and every item) plus a live drive on a scratch copy |
`reference_demo` comments kept: 1 of 5 → 5 of 5; 41 tests | recurse only
into equal-length lists (the old rule) → 21 tests fail |
| Resending a tool keeps its `tool.yaml` |
`server/tests/unit/mcp-tools/resource-manager/prompt/tool-yaml-resend-preservation.test.ts`
plus a live resend of `word_count` and `text_digest` | regenerated (20
comments → 0) → byte-identical; 6 tests | plain serializer, no overlay →
4 fail |
| A tool without `confirm` asks for approval | same file: a new tool
loaded through `ScriptToolDefinitionLoader` | `confirm: false` written →
only supplied fields written, loads with `confirm === true` | restore
`confirm ?? false` → 2 fail |
| The reply names unbound tools and says Updated for an existing one |
`server/tests/unit/mcp-tools/resource-manager/prompt/unset-verb.test.ts`
| dropped tool not mentioned, always "Created" → named with its kept
folder, "Updated" | remove the unbound line → 1 fails; hard-code
"Created" → 1 fails |
| The skills-sync twin follows the new list edit |
`server/tests/integration/skills-sync/export-command.test.ts` P6.259 (a)
| pinned the old padded-bracket output → fixture plus one line; 75/75 |
old list rule → it fails |
| A bundled prompt edited through `resource_manager` on this branch
needs no formatting pass | two calls updating `create_prompt`'s `tools`
text, then `prettier --check` | 2 files, 1 line each, prettier exit 0 |
— |
| Nothing else regressed | `typecheck`, `lint:ratchet`,
`typecheck:tests:ratchet`, `validate:all` | all exit 0; `validate:all`
87/87; published schema 38,466 → 38,619 bytes (ceiling 39,000) | —
(unit, integration and e2e run in CI) |

## Notes for Reviewers

- `server/src/shared/utils/yaml/yaml-document-writer.ts`: list edits are
made on the file's own tokens, and the token output is re-parsed and
must equal the requested value, or the write falls back to re-rendering
the document. That check also catches a scalar string such as `'5'` that
would have been written unquoted and read back as a number.
- In that same file, a comment between list items leaves with the item
below it. A comment above the first item stays with the list. This
follows the yaml library's attachment.
-
`server/src/mcp/tools/resource-manager/prompt/operations/file-operations.ts`:
the `confirm` default change is a behavior change for tools created
without it. It follows the documented default; flag it if you want the
opposite.

## Still open

- Adding or removing a key, or a same-length list whose items change
shape, still re-renders the whole document.

Plan: `plans/reference/prompt-tools-update-2026-10-19.md`
